header.description: What: CE-4649 part D (AN-21a/b/c/d; docs/designs/animals/DESIGN_Animals.md 4c) - on test-town, 15 m east of the North Wood's edge (x 160, y 300-380), a RABBIT sits at (175,340). A rifleman (Friend) walks west toward it along y 340 from (255,340). Judge: (1) the rabbit FREEZES: mode Crouch, its stance Crouched, while the man is still beyond its 12 m panic zone (2) it BOLTS (mode Flee) when he comes near (3) it flees in a ZIGZAG, jinking to both sides of its line (north of y 342 and south of y 338 during the run) (4) it ends INSIDE the wood (x below 160). The unit rail pins >= 4 direction changes of >= 30 degrees. All points are inside 0-400 m. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh an-rabbit-bolts
